investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Verdant Tickets (event ticketing); Platform: AWS us-east-2, Kubernetes cluster vt-prod-use2 (EKS, node range 10.66.0.0/16); Payments: card authorisations are sent by payment-svc to an external payment provider API, protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
